_note: Pages the watchers read (spec/11 U1). Every URL must be on a domain in config/sources_allowlist.json; pipeline.cache refuses anything else. Add an entry when a counterparty's page or feed is confirmed. A counterparty with no entry is listed as a manual check, never guessed.
_release_feeds_note: RSS or Atom feeds on the company's own domain. keep: all keeps every item; keep: nvidia keeps only items that mention Nvidia.
_earnings_pages_note: Investor relations event pages, as {entity, url}. Nvidia's own events page sits behind a browser check, so its dates come from its results filings (Form 8-K item 2.02) and the next date is entered in nvidia_next_earnings below when Nvidia announces it.
_rating_pages_note: Public agency press release pages, as {agency, url}. Moody's, S&P Global Ratings and Fitch publish most rating actions behind a login, so the default is a manual check.
_companies_house_note: UK companies whose register of charges is watched, as {entity, company_number}. Read from find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk.
